about: The latest videos on YouTube for the site's four video buttons, one for each weighting and colouring: usd-age and btc-age, the bars in dollars and in coins stacked in age bands (VIDEO (USD-AGE), VIDEO (BTC-AGE)), and usd-lthsth and btc-lthsth, split into short- and long-term holders (VIDEO (USD-LTH/STH), VIDEO (BTC-LTH/STH)). Written by .github/workflows/video.yml once an upload is viewable (unlisted or public); null until then.
